timeline.card.close_hold_heat: Close windows to hold heat — outdoor's cooler ({outdoor} vs {indoor}).
timeline.card.close_humid: Close the windows — it's humid outside (dew point {dew_point}).
timeline.card.close_not_helping: Close windows — outdoor's not helping now ({outdoor} vs {indoor}).
timeline.card.open_briefly: Open windows briefly — outdoor's warmer ({outdoor} vs {indoor}).
timeline.card.open_cooler: Open windows — outdoor's cooler now ({outdoor} vs {indoor}).
timeline.card.open_unknown: Open windows — outdoor air may be cooler now.
timeline.next_automation.ceiling_guard: AC turns on to hold the ceiling
timeline.next_automation.tou_expansion_e: High-cost period ends — setback back to {temp}
timeline.next_automation.tou_expansion_s: High-cost period starts — setback widens to {temp}
timeline.step.ceiling_guard.default: {t}: CA switches the AC on to hold the {ceiling} ceiling.
timeline.step.held.direction_veto.heat: Keep windows closed to hold heat — outdoor ({outdoor}) would cool the house below its {floor} floor.
timeline.step.held.direction_veto.humid: Keep windows closed for now — it's humid outside (dew point {dew_point}).
timeline.step.held.direction_veto.warm: Keep windows closed for now — outdoor ({outdoor}) isn't cooler than indoor ({indoor}) yet.
timeline.step.held.pause: {base} It applies when the door or window closes.
timeline.step.held.suffix: {base} It applies when CA resumes the schedule at {until}.
timeline.step.mode_change: {t}: the day plan changes from {old} to {new}.
timeline.step.natvent_start: {t}: once a window is open, CA runs the {fan} to bring the cooler air in.
timeline.step.natvent_start.predicted: {t}: CA starts the {fan} (a window is open and outdoor air is cooler).
timeline.step.natvent_stop: {t}: CA stops the {fan} as the window period ends.
timeline.step.occupancy_setback.away: {t}: nobody is home, CA holds the away band, {floor} to {ceiling}, until someone is back.
timeline.step.occupancy_setback.vacation: {t}: vacation mode, CA holds the vacation band, {floor} to {ceiling}, until you return.
timeline.step.pre_cool_start.tou: {t}: CA pre-cools to {target} ahead of the high-cost period at {start}.
timeline.step.pre_cool_start.weather: {t}: CA pre-cools the house to {target} so tomorrow's heat starts from a cooler house.
timeline.step.pre_heat_start.tou: {t}: CA pre-heats to {target} ahead of the high-cost period at {start}.
timeline.step.resume_schedule: {t}: your change ends and CA resumes the schedule ({floor} to {ceiling}).
timeline.step.run.cool: AC runs about {minutes} min between {start} and {end} to hold {edge}.
timeline.step.run.heat: Heat runs about {minutes} min between {start} and {end} to hold {edge}.
timeline.step.setpoint_change.tou_expans: {t}: the high-cost period ends, CA returns to the {occupancy} band, {floor} to {ceiling}.
{t}: high-cost period, CA widens the {occupancy} band to {edge} until {end}.
timeline.step.sleep_band.default: {t}: bedtime, CA switches to the sleep band, {floor} to {ceiling}.
timeline.step.sleep_band.sensor_swap: {t}: bedtime, CA switches to the sleep band, {floor} to {ceiling}, and reads the {sensor} until {wake}.
timeline.step.summary.windows_closed: Keep windows closed for the next {hours} h: no opening helps ({checked} checked).
timeline.step.summary.windows_open: Windows help for {count} period(s) in the next {hours} h.
timeline.step.wake_band.default: {t}: CA switches to the daytime comfort band, {floor} to {ceiling}.
timeline.step.wake_band.sensor_swap: {t}: CA switches to the daytime comfort band, {floor} to {ceiling}, and reads the {sensor} again.
timeline.step.windows_close.bedtime: {t}: bedtime, close the windows before you turn in.
timeline.step.windows_close.comfort_edge: {t}: close the windows before the house drifts below {edge}.
timeline.step.windows_close.horizon: {t}: close the windows when you go to bed or leave.
timeline.step.windows_close.outdoor_rise: {t}: close the windows. Outdoor stops helping (it is warming past the house).
timeline.step.windows_close.planned_end: {t}: close the windows, the planned window period ends.
timeline.step.windows_open.free_cooling: {t}: open the windows. Outdoor is {delta} cooler than the house until about {end}.
timeline.step.windows_open.free_heating: {t}: open the windows. Outdoor is {delta} warmer than the house until about {end}.
timeline.step.windows_open.planned: {t}: open the windows. Outdoor air helps the house until about {end}.
timeline.step_short.ceiling_guard.defaul: Switches the AC on to hold the {ceiling} ceiling.
timeline.step_short.mode_change: The day plan changes from {old} to {new}.

timeline.step_short.occupancy_setback.va: Vacation mode: holds the vacation band, {floor} to {ceiling}, until you return.
timeline.step_short.pre_cool_start.tou: Pre-cools to {target} ahead of the high-cost period at {start}.
timeline.step_short.pre_cool_start.weath: Pre-cools the house to {target} so tomorrow's heat starts from a cooler house.
timeline.step_short.pre_heat_start.tou: Pre-heats to {target} ahead of the high-cost period at {start}.
timeline.step_short.resume_schedule: Your change ends: resumes the schedule ({floor} to {ceiling}).
timeline.step_short.setpoint_change.tou_: The high-cost period ends: returns to the {occupancy} band, {floor} to {ceiling}.

timeline.step_short.sleep_band.default: Bedtime: switches to the sleep band, {floor} to {ceiling}.
timeline.step_short.sleep_band.sensor_sw: Bedtime: switches to the sleep band, {floor} to {ceiling}, and reads the {sensor} until {wake}.
timeline.step_short.wake_band.default: Switches to the daytime comfort band, {floor} to {ceiling}.
timeline.step_short.wake_band.sensor_swa: Switches to the daytime comfort band, {floor} to {ceiling}, and reads the {sensor} again.
timeline.step_short.windows_close.bedtim: Bedtime: close the windows before you turn in.
timeline.step_short.windows_close.comfor: Close the windows before the house drifts below {edge}.
timeline.step_short.windows_close.horizo: Close the windows when you go to bed or leave.
timeline.step_short.windows_close.outdoo: Close the windows. Outdoor stops helping (it is warming past the house).
timeline.step_short.windows_close.planne: Close the windows, the planned window period ends.
timeline.step_short.windows_open.free_co: Open the windows. Outdoor is {delta} cooler than the house until about {end}.

timeline.step_short.windows_open.planned: Open the windows. Outdoor air helps the house until about {end}.
timeline.strip.run_cool_around: Cooling expected for about {minutes} min, around {start} (the plan's window runs to {end}), holding the band's ceiling.
timeline.strip.run_cool_placed: Cooling expected for about {minutes} min between {start} and {end}, holding the band's ceiling.
timeline.strip.run_heat_around: Heating expected for about {minutes} min, around {start} (the plan's window runs to {end}), holding the band's floor.
timeline.strip.run_heat_placed: Heating expected for about {minutes} min between {start} and {end}, holding the band's floor.
timeline.v4.node.headline_rooms: v4 {changed, select, yes {now forecasts} other {forecasts}} each room separately (thermostat by day, bedroom at night)
timeline.v4.node.headline_stitched: v4 {changed, select, yes {now forecasts} other {forecasts}} from the stitched Climate Advisor reading (one model for every room)
timeline.v4.node.headline_thermostat: v4 {changed, select, yes {now forecasts} other {forecasts}} the thermostat's room from its own readings
timeline.v4.node.qual_rooms: both rooms have {need}+ days of readings ({p_name} {pdays}, {s_name} {sdays})
timeline.v4.node.reason_few_anchors: {qual}, but there is not enough shared history yet to compare the two forecasts ({n} points)
timeline.v4.node.reason_no_primary: no thermostat sensor to model on its own
timeline.v4.node.reason_not_fitted: {qual}, but its own model could not be fitted ({why})
timeline.v4.node.reason_primary_not_read: {p_name} has only {pdays} of its own readings (needs {need})
timeline.v4.node.reason_sleep_not_ready: {s_name} has only {sdays} of its own readings (needs {need}) for a model of its own; until then the stitched reading (the bedroom at night) is forecast as one line, and sleep hours are never forecast from {p_name}'s room
timeline.v4.node.reason_stitched_unusabl: {qual} and the stitched model has no usable fit
timeline.v4.node.reason_worse_tol: {qual}, but {score} on this home's history (it may be at most {tol} worse)
timeline.v4.node.score_own: {p_name}'s own forecast scored {b} vs {a} at {h} h{more, select, none {} other { ({others})}}
timeline.v4.node.score_room: the per-room forecast scored {b} vs {a} at {h} h{more, select, none {} other { ({others})}}
timeline.v4.reason.mode_not_observed: heating or cooling not yet observed
timeline.v4.reason.no_beat_4h: does not beat no-change at 4 h by 10 %
timeline.v4.reason.no_beat_cooling: does not beat no-change by 10 % while cooling
timeline.v4.reason.no_beat_heating: does not beat no-change by 10 % while heating
timeline.v4.reason.too_few_starts_used_m: too few accepted thermostat starts in a used mode
timeline.v4.unusable_fit: {n, plural, one {last refit unusable} other {last # refits unusable}} ({reason}); keeping the model from {kept}
timeline.v4.unusable_notice: v4 could not refit your home the last {n} times ({reason}); pre-heat, pre-cool and the other decisions still use the model from {kept}
timeline.v4.why.fit_diverged: the last fit did not settle on a model
timeline.v4.why.mode_not_observed: {modes} not seen (ok needs both heating and cooling)
timeline.v4.why.mode_not_observed_window: {modes} not seen in the last {days} days (ok needs both heating and cooling)
timeline.v4.why.no_beat_4h: it does not yet beat "no change" by 10 % at 4 h ahead
timeline.v4.why.too_few_starts: too few usable {modes} starts (ok needs {need} in each mode it has seen)
timeline.v4.why.too_few_starts_any: too few usable starts (ok needs {need} in each mode it has seen)
